finding.title: Hold the pinned review and plan before parsing their inventories
finding.detail: The review and plan are hashed and separately read before their verified holds. The source/public inventories are enumerated from the cached parsed plan before the plan hold is acquired. A transient replacement can be parsed and approved bytes restored before the hold, so an approved on-disk hash can coexist with a different cached inventory/window. Full public preflight sees the restored approved plan and does not prove the parent held its complete inventory.
finding.reproduction: The disposable Windows proof demonstrates this ordering gap with the actual public hold helper: the approved plan is held and hashed, but an omitted dependency remains writable. This is a source/control race proof, not execution of the private adapter.
finding.requiredCorrection: Acquire the exact final-review hold before parsing the review. Acquire the exact plan hold from that pinned review before plan hashing/parsing. Parse only while the verified handles are active, then derive window/inventories and acquire every remaining hold.

a1Finding.details: A2 adds final child+plan rechecks and uses FileShare.Read holds with hash checks, duplicate-collision checks, path/reparse checks and disposal. EXP-ADAPTER-002 prevents overall source approval.

verifiedProperties: Exact a2 generator/candidate/hold helper/a7 source hashes match the candidate record.
Both source and public binding inventories, exact child, plan, final review, manifest and self are named for holds before child preflight.
A7 validates all 16 future public bindings and an exact preserved-source inventory; this is source mapping, not a generated current plan.
Final pre-DPAPI guard rehashes exact child, generated plan, metadata and review and reserves reviewed time.
ACL/UTC legacy functions remain byte-for-byte unchanged and the exact candidate parses without errors.
Successful and exceptional child cleanup closes all public holds; actual embedded helper controls proved release after success, failure, wrong hash and duplicate collision.
